versions.subject: rule: TAIDOOR malware load https://us-cert.cisa.gov/ncas/analysis-reports/ar20-216a
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'dll,MyStart'
        - 'dll MyStart'
selection2:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - ' MyStart'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*dll,MyStart*", "*dll MyStart*") OR CommandLine="* MyStart"

versions.subject: fix: tightened TAIDOOR rule
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'dll,MyStart'
        - 'dll MyStart'
selection2a:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - ' MyStart'
selection2b:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'rundll32.exe' 
condition: selection1 or ( selection2a and selection2b )
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*dll,MyStart*", "*dll MyStart*") OR (CommandLine="* MyStart" CommandLine="*rundll32.exe*")
